# Next.js Middleware Configuration

This code establishes middleware for a Next.js application with Supabase session management.

**Key Components:**

The middleware imports `NextRequest` from Next.js server utilities and a custom `updateSession` function from the Supabase library. The main middleware function accepts an incoming request and processes it through the session update handler.

The configuration uses a matcher pattern that applies the middleware to most routes while excluding:
- Next.js static assets (`_next/static`)
- Image optimization files (`_next/image`)
- Favicon files
- Common image formats (SVG, PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, WebP)

This setup ensures that session authentication checks run across your application while avoiding unnecessary processing of static resources and optimized images, improving performance and reducing overhead.

    q_iter --> [*]: all cookies copied

        INV-001: All session cookies from source response are copied to destination response

---
title: "updateSession (stem-system middleware.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_init: supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next(request)
    q_init --> q_create_client: supabase = createServerClient(URL, ANON_KEY, cookieHandlers)
    q_create_client --> q_get_user: user = supabase.auth.getUser()
    q_get_user --> q_check_public: isPublicPath = check path prefix

    q_check_public --> q_unauth_protected: !user AND !isPublicPath
    q_check_public --> q_auth_login: user AND path starts with /login
    q_check_public --> q_pass: otherwise

    q_unauth_protected --> q_redirect_login: redirect = NextResponse.redirect(/login)
    q_redirect_login --> q_copy_cookies_login: copySessionCookies(supabaseResponse, redirect)
    q_copy_cookies_login --> [*]: return redirect

    q_auth_login --> q_check_redirect_param: redirectParam = searchParams.get(redirect)
    q_check_redirect_param --> q_validate_redirect: redirectParam exists
    q_check_redirect_param --> q_redirect_dashboard: no redirectParam

    q_validate_redirect --> q_parse_url: redirectUrl = new URL(redirectParam)
    q_parse_url --> q_origin_check: check same origin AND /oauth/ prefix
    q_origin_check --> q_oauth_redirect: origin matches AND path starts with /oauth/
    q_origin_check --> q_redirect_dashboard: origin mismatch OR not /oauth/ path
    q_parse_url --> q_redirect_dashboard: URL parse error (catch)

    q_oauth_redirect --> q_copy_cookies_oauth: copySessionCookies(supabaseResponse, oauthRedirect)
    q_copy_cookies_oauth --> [*]: return oauthRedirect

    q_redirect_dashboard --> q_copy_cookies_dash: copySessionCookies(supabaseResponse, dashRedirect)
    q_copy_cookies_dash --> [*]: return dashRedirect

    q_pass --> [*]: return supabaseResponse

    note right of q_check_public
        INV-001: Public paths are /login, /auth/callback, /oauth, /api
        INV-002: Unauthenticated users cannot access non-public paths
    end note

    note right of q_validate_redirect
        INV-003: Redirect parameter only accepted for same-origin /oauth/ paths (open redirect prevention)
        INV-004: Malformed redirect URLs fall through to dashboard redirect
    end note

    note right of q_create_client
        INV-005: Cookie setAll handler propagates refreshed tokens to both request and response
        INV-006: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY must be defined
    end note

    note right of q_copy_cookies_login
        INV-007: Session cookies are always copied to redirect responses to prevent stale refresh tokens
    end note
